events.title: BOSH SO2 Certification - April 2026 Batch
events.summary: Registration is now open for our upcoming Basic Occupational Safety and Health (BOSH) Training for Safety Officer 2. Secure your slot today!
events.body:
Registration is now open for our upcoming Basic Occupational Safety and Health (BOSH) Training for Safety Officer 2. Secure your slot today!

This training program is fully compliant with the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) standards. It covers essential safety concepts, occupational health hazards, hazard identification, risk assessment and control (HIRAC), and administrative OSH requirements. Safety Officer 2 (SO2) certification is a legal requirement for safety officers operating in the Philippines.

### Who Should Attend?
- Designated Safety Officers
- HR Managers and Personnel
- Engineers and Supervisors
- Members of the OSH Committee

### What is Covered?
- Introduction to OSH legislation and DOLE guidelines
- Industrial hygiene and physical hazards control
- Fire safety, electrical safety, and machine guarding
- Implementing a successful health program in the workplace

Ensure your workplace is compliant and safe. Register today to reserve your slot!

events.title: JLUM Expands Safety Consultation Services
events.summary: We are excited to announce the expansion of our consultancy wing, now offering comprehensive safety audits for the manufacturing sector.
events.body:
We are excited to announce the expansion of our consultancy wing, now offering comprehensive safety audits for the manufacturing sector.

With the rapid growth of industrial operations, compliance with national safety regulations has become more critical than ever. Our expanded team of experienced safety consultants is now ready to assist your organization with professional, field-tested guidance.

### New Service Offerings:
- **Comprehensive Facility Safety Audits**: In-depth reviews of your physical plant and operating procedures.
- **Custom OSH Program Development**: Designing custom safety manuals tailored specifically to your company workflow.
- **Hazard Identification and Risk Assessments (HIRAC)**: Detailed threat modeling and risk management planning.
- **Emergency Preparedness Plan Reviews**: Validating your evacuation, fire, and medical response readiness.

Partner with JL UNI MULTISERV INC. to build a culture of safety and operational excellence.

events.title: First Aid & CPR Basics for Industrial Workers
events.summary: A hands-on workshop designed to equip workers with essential life-saving skills in high-risk environments.
events.body:
A hands-on workshop designed to equip workers with essential life-saving skills in high-risk environments.

This intensive training program offers practical experience in basic life support, cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR), first aid administration, and responding to common workplace emergencies such as burns, fractures, and choking.

### Key Highlights:
- Hands-on CPR practice with adult and infant manikins
- First aid drills and simulated emergency scenarios
- Certificate of completion valid for regulatory compliance
- Experienced emergency response instructors

Equip your team with the skills to save lives. Register now!
